description: This file defines the PocketRepositoryWrapper class, which provides an abstraction over PocketRepository, facilitating operations like saving pockets and retrieving pocket IDs by app user ID, with additional logic for exception handling if pockets are not found.

classes.name: PocketRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper service that encapsulates database operations related to Pocket entities, providing methods to save pockets and retrieve pocket IDs by user ID, with built-in exception handling.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Delegates saving and flushing a Pocket entity to the underlying repository.

methods.name: findByAppUserId
methods.description: Retrieves a Pocket ID associated with a given application user ID.

methods.name: findByAppUserIdWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves a Pocket ID by user ID, throws exception if not found.
